name: Control panel toggles
oneLiner: a smoked-glass control panel rises tile by tile in slow 3D: the wireless switches pop on in the brand colour one at a time, the brightness and volume wells fill white to their levels, a few square toggles flip white, then the mode label rolls through the modes and settles on the last one as its tile lights white and lifts toward the camera
say: when the speaker describes switching into a mode or setting things up just right ('I flip everything into work mode', 'phone on silent, lights down, and I start'): the switches flip under the list and the mode label settles on its name. Set modes (the last one is where it lands) and sub
